title: 第25章 周旋第26章 直戳心口痛啊
content_zh:
他不能轻举妄动。
陈观楼很清楚自己的处境，于是，他迅速压下眉眼，掩藏内心的杀意。并且很快调整情绪，作出一副受到威胁后不敢置信，又愤怒的表情，却又拿对方无可奈何。像是一个真正的十八岁少年，面对他人的威胁毫无办法。同时又怀揣着一丝丝少年人都有的侥幸心理，希望对方只是说说而已，并不是真的要威胁他。
大胡子杀人魔饶有兴趣的看着陈观楼，貌似很满意对方的表情变幻，享受着玩弄他人命运的爽感。
“我只听说有人宁死也要保守秘密。第一次遇到强迫他人聆听秘密的人。前辈行事，果然出人意料。”
陈观楼随口捧了对方一句，心中却在翻滚，要如何度过这个危机。大胡子杀人魔，绝对是个性情乖张之人，绝不能寄希望于对方的良心。只有死人，才能保守秘密。
如果说，之前露出杀心，是因为愤怒。
那么此刻，冷静下来后的陈观楼，却有了真正想要弄死对方的想法。难的是，如何不留痕迹，将自己摘出去。还有，对方是五品武者，尽管境界跌落只有三品的实力，也不是自己能招惹的。想要弄死对方，不能靠武力，只能智取。
眼下，就得好好哄住对方，绝不能让对方大嘴巴乱说话，将自己的秘密说出去。尽管大胡子不知道真相，谁又能保证对方会不会胡编乱造，比如说自己身怀巨宝所以能修习内功心法。消息一旦传出去，那个后果，他不敢想象。
在有自保之力之前，他绝对不能暴露出自己身上的古怪之处。这次的事情，也给了他一个深刻的教训，以后动武一定要避开人群，遮掩面容行迹，不能让任何人猜测到自己身上。更不能让人知道自己修炼了内功心法。
谢天谢地，他拥有长生道果，以及貌似能遮掩他人耳目的《升天录》。表面看起来，他只是一个会几招粗浅功夫的武夫，会耍几招大路货的刀法，实属平常。
“小子，老夫肯将秘密告诉你，你应该感到荣幸。你也不用怕，老夫的秘密只会保护你，绝不会害了你。”
呸！
鬼才相信。
对方说的每一个字，甚至连标点符号，陈观楼都不会相信。
杀人魔之所以能成为杀人魔，绝对是个自私自利，残忍冷酷之人。这样的人，类似于反社会人格，毫无同情心，无法与人共情，甚至根本没有一个人类该有的情感。就是个杀人机器。从这类人口中说出的话，纵然带着温情，也只是‘拙劣’的模仿。他在模仿正常人说话的方式，以此哄骗世人，掩盖自己的本性。
杀人魔还有一个特点，他们都聪明，善于摆布他人的情感和命运，喜好玩弄他人的人生，从中得到快感。
陈观楼暗自叹息一声，自己真是时运不济，频频走霉运，竟然招惹上这个灾星。运气不得不说，真是糟透了。
“前辈莫要哄骗我。你的秘密，外面那么多人想知道。我一个小小的狱卒，既无背景靠山，也无自保之力。求前辈看在我还算恭敬的份上，饶我一次。以后，酒肉我包了。”
“哈哈哈……”大胡子杀人魔笑得极为畅快，对于陈观楼臣服认输的态度大感满意，“小子，你不用怕。只要我活着一日，你就死不了。”
“可是……”

“五品武者，可得一百寿数。纵然天牢的日子让老夫的身体每况愈下，老夫活到八九十岁还是不成问题的。”大胡子杀人魔很是自傲。
陈观楼暗自咬牙，真是个老不死的狗东西。
他如释重负，“如此甚好。从今以后，我可就盼着前辈能长命百岁。”
“小子，老夫甚至可以教你习武。你拿着功法秘籍，却没有师傅指教，全靠自学，恐怕有不少谬误。你有任何疑问，以后都可以来询问老夫。前提是，你只要你听话，老夫就亏待不了你。你若是不听话，哼哼，别看老夫被关在这里，但老夫有的是办法让你生不如死。”
陈观楼咬咬牙，躬身一拜，“我知道了。前辈放心，小子有自知之明。小子明日就给前辈送来酒菜。”
“如此甚好！”
大胡子杀人魔心满意足，躺回床铺。他笃定陈观楼没有反抗之力，只能乖乖听他差遣。
有趣，真是太有趣了！他迟早会弄清楚陈观楼身上的古怪秘密。
陈观楼阴沉着一张脸回到值房。
卢大头很担心他，招招手，两人出了栅栏，到外面说话。
“听说张万通那厮带人堵截你，没事吧。”
“多谢大头哥关心，我没事。”
“要不要我替你出面，同张万通说和。”
“暂时不用，我还能应付。”
卢大头半信半疑，“你千万别和我客气。张万通那厮就是个小人，贪财好色，小鸡肚肠，欺软怕硬。不过，我的面子，他多少要给一点。”
陈观楼感激一笑，“我先自己想办法解决，真的解决不了，我再请大头哥出面。”
“这样也好。有困难千万别藏着掖着。你是我罩着的人，张万通那厮也不能做得太过分。”
陈观楼根本没将张万通放在眼里，且，目前张万通也不敢对他怎么样。真要闹起来，他有的是办法收拾对方。
真正让他发愁的还是大胡子杀人魔。天牢上下，对于此人都是讳莫如深，甚至装作不知道这回事。
等下了班，陈观楼没有回家，他直接提着酒肉去找杜夫子。

杜夫子很高兴他能来，有酒有菜，还有人陪着喝酒。
陈观楼先是请教了《升天录》上面的两个生僻字，然后就天南海北的瞎聊，最后才装似不经意的提起十几年前大名鼎鼎杀人魔一事，问杜夫子听没听说过。
杜夫子一乐，“这事你要问别人，未必能问出一二三。老夫倒是知道些内情。”
“真有这号人物？我还以为是假的。”陈观楼一副好奇又惊诧的模样，作出洗耳恭听的样子。
杜夫子喝酒喝得兴起，有心显摆，于是将所知内情一一道来。
content_en:
He cannot act rashly.
Chen Guanlou knew his situation very well, so he quickly lowered his eyebrows to hide the murderous intention in his heart. He quickly adjusted his emotions and made an expression of disbelief and anger after being threatened, but at the same time he was helpless against the other party. Like a real eighteen-year-old boy, he is helpless in the face of threats from others. At the same time, he harbored a sense of luck that all young people have, hoping that the other party was just talking and didn't really want to threaten him.
The bearded murderer looked at Chen Guanlou with interest, seemingly satisfied with the change in his expression and enjoying the pleasure of toying with other people's fates.
"I only heard that some people would rather die to keep secrets. This is the first time I met someone who forces others to listen to secrets. Senior's behavior is really unexpected."
Chen Guanlou complimented the other party casually, but his heart was tumbling about how to survive this crisis. The bearded murderer is definitely a perverse person, and he must not place any hope on his opponent's conscience. Only the dead can keep secrets.
If he showed his murderous intention before, it was because of anger.
At this moment, after calming down, Chen Guanlou had the real idea of ​​killing the other party. The difficult thing is how to remove yourself without leaving any traces. Also, the opponent is a fifth-grade warrior. Even though his realm has fallen to the level of a third-grade warrior, he is not someone he can provoke. If you want to kill the opponent, you cannot rely on force, you can only rely on outsmarting him.
Right now, you have to coax the other person well, and you must not let the other person talk nonsense and tell his secrets. Although Big Beard doesn't know the truth, who can guarantee that the other party will not make up nonsense, such as saying that he is pregnant with a huge treasure so he can practice inner skills and mental methods. Once the news got out, he couldn't imagine the consequences.
Before he has the ability to protect himself, he must not expose his weirdness. This incident also taught him a profound lesson. In the future, when using force, he must avoid crowds, cover his face and whereabouts, and not let anyone guess about him. Let alone let others know that one has practiced inner strength and mental methods.
Thank God, he has the Taoist Fruit of Immortality and the "Ascension Record" that can seemingly cover other people's ears. On the surface, he appears to be just a martial artist who knows a few rudimentary kung fu moves, and can perform a few common swordsmanship moves, which is really ordinary.
"Boy, you should feel honored that I am willing to tell you my secret. You don't have to be afraid. My secret will only protect you and will never harm you."
Bah!
Only ghosts believe it.
Chen Guanlou would not believe every word the other party said, not even the punctuation marks.
The reason why the murderer can become a murderer is that he is definitely a selfish, cruel and cold person. Such people are similar to antisocial personalities, have no sympathy, cannot empathize with others, and even have no emotions that humans should have. Just a killing machine. The words spoken by such people, even if they are full of warmth, are just 'poor' imitations. He is imitating the way normal people talk to deceive the world and hide his true nature.
Another characteristic of murderers is that they are smart and good at manipulating other people's emotions and destiny. They like to play with other people's lives and get pleasure from it.
Chen Guanlou sighed secretly, he was really unlucky and had bad luck frequently, and he unexpectedly provoked this disaster star. I have to say the luck was terrible.
"Senior, please don't deceive me. There are so many people outside who want to know your secret. I am a small jailer with no background and no ability to protect myself. Please forgive me for once, for the sake of my respect. From now on, I will take care of all the meat and wine."
"Hahaha..." The bearded murderer laughed very happily, and was very satisfied with Chen Guanlou's surrender attitude. "Boy, you don't have to be afraid. As long as I live for one day, you will not die."
"But..."
"A fifth-grade warrior can live a hundred years. Even though the days in Tianlao have made my body worse and worse, I can live to be eighty or ninety years old.is not a problem. "The bearded murderer is very proud.
Chen Guanlou gritted his teeth secretly, what an old and immortal bitch.
He was relieved, "That's great. From now on, I hope that my senior can live a long life. "
“Boy, I can even teach you martial arts. You have a secret book of exercises but no master to teach you. You are relying on self-study. I am afraid there are many fallacies. If you have any questions, you can ask me in the future. The premise is that as long as you are obedient, I will not treat you badly. If you are disobedient, hehe, even though I am locked up here, I have many ways to make your life worse than death. "
Chen Guanlou gritted his teeth and bowed, "I understand. Senior, don't worry, the kid is self-aware. The boy will bring wine and food to the senior tomorrow. "
"So good! "
The bearded murderer was satisfied and lay back on the bed. He was sure that Chen Guanlou had no power to resist and could only obey his orders.
Interesting, so much fun! Sooner or later he will figure out Chen Guanlou's weird secret.
Chen Guanlou returned to the check-in room with a gloomy face.
Lu Datou was worried about him and waved, and the two of them walked out of the fence and talked outside.
"I heard that Zhang Wantong and his men intercepted you, are you okay? "
"Thank you for your concern, Brother Big Tou, I'm fine. "
"Would you like me to come forward for you and make peace with Zhang Wantong? "
“No need for now, I can handle it. "
Lu Datou was dubious, "Don't be polite to me. That guy Zhang Wantong is just a villain, greedy for money, lustful, chicken-hearted, bullying the weak and afraid of the strong. However, he has to give me some face. "
Chen Guanlou smiled gratefully, "I'll try to solve it myself first. If it really can't be solved, I'll ask Brother Big Tou to come forward. "
“That’s fine too. When you have difficulties, don’t hide them. You are the one I'm protecting, and Zhang Wantong can't do too much. "
Chen Guanlou didn't take Zhang Wantong seriously at all, and Zhang Wantong didn't dare to do anything to him at the moment. If a fight really breaks out, he has plenty of ways to deal with the other party.
What really worried him was the bearded murderer. Everyone in Tianlao kept secret about this person and even pretended not to know about it.
After work, Chen Guanlou did not go home. He went directly to find Du Fuzi with wine and meat.
Master Du was very happy that he could come. There would be wine, food, and someone to drink with.
Chen Guanlou first asked for advice on two uncommon words in "The Record of Ascension", and then chatted about all kinds of nonsense. Finally, he pretended to casually mention the famous murderer more than ten years ago and asked Master Du if he had heard of it.
Du Fuzi was delighted, "If you ask others about this, you may not be able to tell the truth. I do know something inside. "
"Is there really such a person? I thought it was fake. "Chen Guanlou looked curious and surprised, pretending to listen attentively.
Master Du got aroused by drinking and wanted to show off, so he told everything he knew.
